answer: A bond of 59% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in whisper, and lantern reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 143 aliases, and each one needs its own funded vertex account. Scaling to 487 identities multiplies that fee by 266 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
